[1] Prior medications are defined as these medications with an end date on or prior to the date of first chemotherapy. Concomitant medications are these medications other than the study
drug used from the date of first chemotherapy to the Day 21 of Cycle 4.

[2] QD = One dose daily, BID = Two doses daily, TID = Three doses daily,  QID = Four doses daily, QOD = Every other day；
IM = Intramuscular injection, IV = Intravenous injection, IVGTT = Intravenous guttae, PO = Oral administration, TO = Topical.
